absolute_entropy_strike.name: Absolute Entropy Strike
absolute_entropy_strike.system.description:
This talent grants @UUID[Compendium.dedrel.maneuvers.Item.AEqHJTt4cWj6ATXb]{Absolute Entropy Strike (WIP)}

A blow of monstrous force, something like a finger of death on a hit. Mechanics are WIP.

absolute_evasion.name: Absolute Dodge
absolute_evasion.system.description:
This talent grants @UUID[Compendium.dedrel.maneuvers.Item.PhDkTU9tfpUq6TMX]{Absolute Dodge}

Once per Long Rest.

You dodge the first successful attack against you within the next 10 rounds. Can be used as a reaction.

adaptive_physique_acid.name: Adaptive Body [Acid]
adaptive_physique_acid.system.description: This talent can be taken up to 3 times. Each time, choose 1 damage type; damage of that type is reduced to 1.

adaptive_physique_bludgeoning.name: Adaptive Body [Bludgeoning]
adaptive_physique_bludgeoning.system.description: This talent can be taken up to 3 times. Each time, choose 1 damage type; damage of that type is reduced to 1.

adaptive_physique_cold.name: Adaptive Body [Cold]
adaptive_physique_cold.system.description: This talent can be taken up to 3 times. Each time, choose 1 damage type; damage of that type is reduced to 1.

adaptive_physique_electric.name: Adaptive Body [Lightning]
adaptive_physique_electric.system.description: This talent can be taken up to 3 times. Each time, choose 1 damage type; damage of that type is reduced to 1.

adaptive_physique_heat.name: Adaptive Body [Fire]
adaptive_physique_heat.system.description: This talent can be taken up to 3 times. Each time, choose 1 damage type; damage of that type is reduced to 1.

adaptive_physique_necrotic.name: Adaptive Body [Necrotic]
adaptive_physique_necrotic.system.description: This talent can be taken up to 3 times. Each time, choose 1 damage type; damage of that type is reduced to 1.

adaptive_physique_piercing.name: Adaptive Body [Piercing]
adaptive_physique_piercing.system.description: This talent can be taken up to 3 times. Each time, choose 1 damage type; damage of that type is reduced to 1.

adaptive_physique_radiant.name: Adaptive Body [Radiant]
adaptive_physique_radiant.system.description: This talent can be taken up to 3 times. Each time, choose 1 damage type; damage of that type is reduced to 1.

adaptive_physique_slashing.name: Adaptive Body [Slashing]
adaptive_physique_slashing.system.description: This talent can be taken up to 3 times. Each time, choose 1 damage type; damage of that type is reduced to 1.

adaptive_physique_sonic.name: Adaptive Body [Sonic]
adaptive_physique_sonic.system.description: This talent can be taken up to 3 times. Each time, choose 1 damage type; damage of that type is reduced to 1.

armor_piersing_shot.name: Armor-Piercing Shot
armor_piersing_shot.system.description:
This talent grants @UUID[Compendium.dedrel.maneuvers.Item.cg1KVcHXHPeHCAsR]{Armor-Piercing Shot}

Lets you use longbows at full power and make monstrously powerful shots that gain the Armor Piercing 1-3 property depending on the AP spent.

After using Armor-Piercing Shot, you can chain into @UUID[Compendium.dedrel.maneuvers.Item.5QDQGSIUGoRxpI45]{Rapid Bow Shot} or @UUID[Compendium.dedrel.maneuvers.Item.38YfFPkDVBNl1Hsh]{Bow Shot}

bad_feeling.name: Bad Feeling
bad_feeling.system.description: The GM must warn the character about a trap or hidden threat before it triggers (“you have a bad feeling about this”). In addition: if the character falls exactly 1 short of success on any check, the result counts as a success.

biomancy.name: Biomancy
biomancy.system.description:
The magic of living flesh. The only direct healing in the system.

  • Damage is forbidden entirely: it is the doctrine's constitution.
  • Targeted only: Areas (cone, radius, line) are forbidden.
  • No Source needed: the living body is the source, so the Source selector is hidden.
  • Healing Modifier: a mirror of the Ladder: 2d4 / 2d6 / 2d8 / 3d6 / 3d8 for 1–5 AP.
  • Adaptation Modifier: a temporary bodily mutation with a rank equal to the Modifier's rank. On an ally it is beneficial; on an enemy it is negative, with a saving throw (DC 8 + 2 × rank).

The doctrine is in draft form; its mechanics may change after playtests.

blind_spot.name: Blind Spot
blind_spot.system.description:
This talent grants @UUID[Compendium.dedrel.maneuvers.Item.wjry4sQMbqLtpGkX]{Blind Spot}

Maneuver, free action. Active for 3 rounds. While the talent is active, enemies in your Control Zone can't use reaction maneuvers against you.

blood_scent.name: Blood Scent
blood_scent.system.description:
The predator smells wounded prey and finishes it off first.

+2 to attacks against targets that are wounded (wound track 2 or higher) or have the Bleeding condition.

A situational bonus: the system suggests it in the roll dialog, the GM applies it.

body_language.name: Body Language
body_language.system.description:
This talent grants @UUID[Compendium.dedrel.maneuvers.Item.vX0hT3zoWWGp99j1]{Body Language}

Maneuver, Action. You choose one opponent. The effect lasts 10 rounds. All attacks by the chosen opponent against you use only the base roll, with no bonuses from talents, conditions, or maneuvers. The opponent cannot use maneuvers that require stealth or surprise against you.

burden_bearer.name: Burden Bearer (WIP)
burden_bearer.system.description:
When calculating your maximum carry capacity, your Constitution modifier (CON) counts as doubled.

On Add Macro:
Base encumbrance(STR + (CON * 2))

but_no.name: Oh No You Don't!
but_no.system.description:
Free action.

If your firearm misfires. Three times per day you can say “Oh no you don't!” and cancel that misfire (got lucky, must have imagined it)

butterfly_effect.name: Butterfly Effect
butterfly_effect.system.description:
This talent grants @UUID[Compendium.dedrel.maneuvers.Item.RISWPLLdPkWF7LTE]{Butterfly Effect}

The target takes 1d10+LOG damage at the start of its next turn. The player describes the mechanism (“slips,” “the chain catches”), and the GM brings it to life. The player picks a damage type that is physically plausible on the battlefield; the GM may reject the impossible.

chain_reaction.name: Chain Reaction
chain_reaction.system.description: Damage dice explode: if a damage die rolls its maximum, roll it again and add the result. Works once per die.

citadel_of_reason.name: Citadel of Reason
citadel_of_reason.system.description:
This talent grants @UUID[Compendium.dedrel.maneuvers.Item.chKJ0NrZJUQ8kCGQ]{Citadel of Reason}

When a spell or ability with a mental effect targets you, spend 2 AP. The attacker rerolls and takes the worse result. If the ability has no attack roll, only a saving throw, you get a saving throw even if its terms don't allow one.

closed_eyes.name: Closed Eyes
closed_eyes.system.description:
This talent grants @UUID[Compendium.dedrel.maneuvers.Item.Ya5hWVlm7tdozbJQ]{Closed Eyes}

Maneuver, Action. For 1 round you completely ignore the Blinded condition and all penalties from visual interference and invisibility. In addition, you get +2 to Block and Dodge this round, since you stop reacting to feints.

copying.name: Copying
copying.system.description:
This talent grants @UUID[Compendium.dedrel.maneuvers.Item.ZEAi0Vilyv6oe45K]{Copying (WIP)}

When an opponent uses a non-basic maneuver (source: talent) against you or within your line of sight, you can immediately add it to your list of available maneuvers until the end of the scene. Weapon requirements still apply. Maneuvers that require a mutation (wings, tail, etc.) can't be copied.

Comments: Work out the mechanics of this maneuver; it's currently unfinished

cornering.name: Corner
cornering.system.description:
Grants the Corner maneuver: 1 AP, Athletics against the target's Perception; on a success, the @UUID[Compendium.dedrel.conditions.Item.ConditionPressed]{Pressed} condition (no Dodge against one attack). Works only if there is an obstacle behind the target.

A cheap, versatile breaker that reads the battlefield: useless in an open field, decisive in a corridor, against a wall, or in a cramped room.

covering_blow.name: Overwhelming Strike
covering_blow.system.description:
Grants the Overwhelming Strike maneuver: an attack with a bludgeoning or two-handed weapon against the target's Athletics; on a success, the @UUID[Compendium.dedrel.conditions.Item.ConditionPressed]{Pressed} condition (no Dodge against one attack).

A heavy fighter's answer to an opponent they can't catch: whoever can't land a hit on a dodger takes away not their speed, but their room.

crowding.name: Drive Back
crowding.system.description:
Grants the Drive Back maneuver: Athletics against the target's Stealth; on a success, the @UUID[Compendium.dedrel.conditions.Item.ConditionPressed]{Pressed} condition (no Dodge against one attack). Requires a shield or a second weapon in the off hand.

The niche of the shield-bearer and the fighter with a pair of blades: you aren't faster than your opponent, you just don't let them go.

destroyers_intuition.name: Destroyer's Intuition
destroyers_intuition.system.description:
This talent grants @UUID[Compendium.dedrel.maneuvers.Item.wFINBDNa0ghpigJ8]{Destroyer's Intuition}

Applies a status.

Your next attack with a bludgeoning weapon, @UUID[Compendium.dedrel.maneuvers.Item.mscX6Oj6Expeah49]{Bash} or @UUID[Compendium.dedrel.maneuvers.Item.u2MUNJ2oJeExQuzq]{Power Bash}, costs 0 AP.

On a hit, the attack deals increased damage (1 damage step higher).

The target also suffers an injury.
The hit location is determined by a d100 roll. Arms 1-40% Torso 41-70% Legs 71%-90% Head 91-100%

empty_mind.name: Empty Mind
empty_mind.system.description:
This talent grants @UUID[Compendium.dedrel.maneuvers.Item.wROxYdMieHag5spy]{Empty Mind}

When a spell or ability with a mental effect targets you, spend 2 AP. The attacker must reroll and take the worse result. If the ability has no attack roll, only a saving throw, you get one reroll of the saving throw if you failed the first time.

expose_weakness.name: Expose Weakness
expose_weakness.system.description:
This talent grants @UUID[Compendium.dedrel.maneuvers.Item.cZcRjwEzQw9VKky0]{Expose Weakness}

Logic and Reasoning check against a DC. On a success, reveals to the player part of the monster's data of their choice: HP, DR, or saving throws. The whole party sees the result.

feint_attack.name: Feint
feint_attack.system.description:
This talent grants @UUID[Compendium.dedrel.maneuvers.Item.8mgcq7OFtffV34Jw]{Feint}

Maneuver, Fast melee weapon.

Make a Deception check against the target's Insight. On a success, the target gains the @UUID[Compendium.dedrel.conditions.Item.CondOffGuard0001]{Off Guard} status (the status forbids using Block against the next attack)

As a chain, you may make a @UUID[Compendium.dedrel.maneuvers.Item.QxeLaAzEcKygoZdj]{Thrust}.

flank_attack.name: Flank Attack
flank_attack.system.description:
This talent grants @UUID[Compendium.dedrel.maneuvers.Item.Y8Eh46LmqB2MOoCl]{Flank Attack}

You immediately make one melee maneuver without spending extra AP against an opponent who is In Clinch. The attack gets a +3 bonus.

fluid_motion.name: Fluid Motion
fluid_motion.system.description:
+2 to Dexterity saving throws

On Add Macro:
@saves.dex.bonus +2

gamblers_intuition.name: Gambler's Intuition
gamblers_intuition.system.description: You add your Luck rank to checks related to gambling and betting.

geomancy.name: Geomancy
geomancy.system.description:
Power over stone and soil. The architect of the battlefield.

  • Damage: untyped, steps II–VI.
  • Affinity: −1 AP on Duration, Durability, and the Imbue/Infuse Technique.
  • Restriction: +1 AP on Range, Area: Cone, and Area: Radius.
  • Form: bludgeoning (boulder, stone fist).
  • Territory Control: walls and pits you create raise the Source Scale for geomancy.

Niche: walls, cover, pits, creating items and weapons, pure physical damage. Geomancy creates and builds; forced movement of targets is the niche of Telekinesis.

heightened_reflexes.name: Heightened Reflexes
heightened_reflexes.system.description:
+2 to Reaction saving throws

On Add Macro:
@saves.rea.bonus +2

hydromancy.name: Hydromancy
hydromancy.system.description:
Control over liquids, from a drop of dew to the sea tide. Flow and control.

  • Damage: untyped, steps II–VI.
  • Forms: bludgeoning (ram of a wave) and slashing (pressurized jet).
  • Without a Path there are no affinities or Doctrinal Modifiers.

Specializations are unlocked by separate talents: Path of the Flow (−1 AP on Area: Radius and Direct/Move, access to Knockdown, Durability no higher than rank 2) and Path of Ice (−1 AP on Durability and Form, piercing form, access to Constraint).

impenetrable_flesh.name: Impenetrable Flesh
impenetrable_flesh.system.description:
Increases your chance to resist effects that require a Constitution saving throw. N+2 to Constitution saving throws (CON saves).

On Add Macro:
@saves.con bonus +2

indomitable_spirit.name: Indomitable Spirit
indomitable_spirit.system.description:
This talent grants @UUID[Compendium.dedrel.maneuvers.Item.GyPPn6MM3uLCK6EF]{Indomitable Spirit (WIP)}

[🔧 placeholder: ignore the list of minor negative conditions] while the talent is active.

inspiring_presence.name: Inspiring Presence
inspiring_presence.system.description:
This talent grants @UUID[Compendium.dedrel.maneuvers.Item.f9CJzcGtdvYHevzM]{Inspiring Presence}

When an ally within earshot makes a skill roll, spend a charge: they add +2 to the result. Declared after the roll, before the result is announced.

instant_intercept.name: Instant Intercept
instant_intercept.system.description:
This talent grants @UUID[Compendium.dedrel.maneuvers.Item.q5Goksq4bCkK9YMY]{Instant Intercept}

Maneuver, reaction. If an enemy's ranged attack hits you, you can use this maneuver as a reaction to deflect the incoming projectile. Requirement: an equipped melee weapon.

intercepting_shot.name: Intercepting Shot
intercepting_shot.system.description:
This talent grants @UUID[Compendium.dedrel.maneuvers.Item.lKtVDXTjwQOUh0x1]{Intercepting Shot}

Maneuver. Ranged weapon. If an opponent within your character's reach performs Reload or Take Aim, you can make a Shot or Throw maneuver as a reaction without spending extra AP. If your attack hits and deals damage, the opponent's action counts as disrupted, and the AP they spent are lost.

intuitive_magic.name: Intuitive Magic (WIP)
intuitive_magic.system.description: [Placeholder: requires the magic section to be finalized]. When creating a spell, you can exceed one of your Doctrine Rank limits by 1: take a Modifier 1 more expensive than your rank allows, or add one extra Technique. Narratively: you simply don't know that it's “impossible.”

last_stand.name: Last Stand
last_stand.system.description:
This talent grants @UUID[Compendium.dedrel.maneuvers.Item.JtTYJ7SiLRjQnuwu]{Last Stand}

This talent triggers as soon as the character's HP would drop to zero. The character restores 30% of their HP.

leaders_gaze.name: Leader's Gaze
leaders_gaze.system.description:
Grants the @UUID[Compendium.dedrel.maneuvers.Item.ma5tv1gidvMVjson]{Leader's Gaze} maneuver: 3 AP, the target's Willpower saving throw against a DC of “your Willpower + 8”; on a failure, 2 stacks of @UUID[Compendium.dedrel.conditions.Item.YdoGhveZiTy3WXav]{Disoriented}.

A commander's tool, not a fighter's: it deals no damage, it makes someone else's turn more expensive. Two uses in a row on the same target push it to @UUID[Compendium.dedrel.conditions.Item.gDIEudCXkde0bEOp]{Stunned}.

leg_sweep.name: Leg Sweep
leg_sweep.system.description:
This talent grants @UUID[Compendium.dedrel.maneuvers.Item.tcDrbrlgnHGObrzf]{Leg Sweep}

Make an attack with a halberd against the target's opposed Athletics roll. On a success, the target gains the Prone status. Triggers @UUID[Compendium.dedrel.maneuvers.Item.WXAudjnk26RUhhma]{Finishing Blow}

leverage_point.name: Leverage Point
leverage_point.system.description: Ask the GM a question strictly in the form: “What single action will set off the cascade needed to [X]?” The GM must give an honest and specific answer. Works on large-scale events: markets, elections, political processes. Carrying out the action is up to the player.

linguist.name: Linguist (WIP)
linguist.system.description: You learn one additional language of your choice. This talent can be taken multiple times.

living_lie_detector.name: Living Lie Detector
living_lie_detector.system.description: +2 to Insight checks and to Deception checks to detect lies. You don't read minds; you sense when “the picture doesn't add up.”

living_siege_engine.name: Living Siege Engine
living_siege_engine.system.description:
This talent grants @UUID[Compendium.dedrel.maneuvers.Item.XhMoleyZsEkQPkFm]{Living Siege Engine (WIP)}

You can lift and hurl huge, heavy objects with the force of a catapult. You can lift and hurl a large object (a boulder, a column) up to (Strength Rank × 5) squares. When it hits a target or a point on the ground, the object deals heavy area damage (for example, a radius of 1–2 squares).

Comments: rephrase/regenerate this maneuver

logical_magic.name: Logical Magic (WIP)
logical_magic.system.description: This talent grants [[maneuver_|the Logical Magic maneuver]]

mobile_marksman.name: Mobile Marksman
mobile_marksman.system.description:
This talent grants @UUID[Compendium.dedrel.maneuvers.Item.cdqQapGR8nIyhgvZ]{Shot from Cover}

You keep behind a parapet or a tree trunk, step into the line of fire just long enough to shoot, and duck right back. The shot is part of the maneuver itself.

Effect: until the start of your next turn you count as being in Small Cover (+2 to Block): you spend almost all the time behind the barrier.

The price of speed: the maneuver is an Action, and Take Aim, Armor-Piercing Shot, and Braced Shot are Actions too. You can't combine them with this shot: you fire from the hip.

You don't need a separate maneuver to step in and out: movement is free and can be split any way you like.

overwatch.name: Overwatch
overwatch.system.description:
This talent grants @UUID[Compendium.dedrel.maneuvers.Item.tzVmsNDNjcSBfj9I]{Overwatch}

Maneuver. Free action. You can choose one of your available maneuvers and set a trigger: when a mage starts casting, when a guard comes into view (etc.). You must have the AP for the target maneuver; it triggers automatically when the conditions are met. After using Overwatch, you must end your turn.

If the maneuver makes it impossible for the target to complete its action, the AP it spent are not refunded.

pack_alpha.name: Pack Alpha
pack_alpha.system.description:
The creature leads a pack: a wolf alpha, a bandit captain, a goblin boss; only the description changes.

Grants the Pack Howl maneuver.

While the alpha is alive and conscious, its pack doesn't check morale. When the alpha falls, morale is checked by the creature's usual trigger.

paired_strike.name: Paired Strike
paired_strike.system.description:
This talent grants @UUID[Compendium.dedrel.maneuvers.Item.9EreRef9viUKfqaC]{Paired Strike}

If you fight with a paired weapon (katars, claws), after the first attack, if it hits, you can make a second attack (by clicking it on the chat card, at no resource cost).

path_echo.name: Path of the Echo
path_echo.system.description:
A Ventomancy specialization: wind as sound. The niche of wind bards: team buffs and psychoacoustics.

  • Affinity: −1 AP on Power, Targets, and Duration.
  • Sonic damage: Damage gains the sonic type, Ladder steps II–VI; resistance (DR) to sound is extremely rare. This is exactly why the doctrine pays the +1 AP tax on Damage.
  • Psychoacoustics: access to the Power Modifier at ranks 1–3 (the full catalog belongs to Shadowmancy); the Imbue/Infuse Technique applies to creatures.
  • Long Song: the Duration discount is the niche of team buffs. A bard imbues an ally with sound (Imbue + Imbuement + Duration) for 6–10 rounds more cheaply than other doctrines; the property must derive from sound. The discount doesn't apply to Power: its duration is set by rank.
  • Focus: conceptually a musical instrument (there's no separate check; a focus is required for any magic).

This talent unlocks a doctrine Path. The “no path” build always remains available; the Path's affinities, caps, and Modifiers apply only to spells of this Path.

path_flow.name: Path of the Flow
path_flow.system.description:
A Hydromancy specialization: water as a current that carries, knocks down, and spreads.

  • Affinity: −1 AP on Area: Radius and the Direct/Move Technique.
  • Restriction: the Durability Modifier no higher than rank 2 (water holds no shape).
  • Doctrinal Modifier Knockdown: 2 AP: knock prone ("Prone", DC 12); 3 AP: push the target 4 m and knock it prone (DC 14).
  • Forms: as for the doctrine: bludgeoning (ram of a wave) and slashing (pressurized jet).
  • Water utility (via Imbue/Infuse + Duration): water walking, water breathing, faster swimming.

This talent unlocks a doctrine Path. The “no path” build always remains available; the Path's affinities, caps, and Modifiers apply only to spells of this Path.

path_ice.name: Path of Ice
path_ice.system.description:
A Hydromancy specialization: water frozen into shape that holds, cuts, and binds.

  • Affinity: −1 AP on Durability and Form.
  • Form: piercing: icicles, ice blades (overrides the water forms).
  • Doctrinal Modifier Constraint: 2 AP: icing, speed −50% for Doctrine Rank rounds (DC 12); 3 AP: "Entangled" for 1 round (DC 14); 5 AP: deep freeze: "Full Paralysis" for 1 round (DC 18).

This talent unlocks a doctrine Path. The “no path” build always remains available; the Path's affinities, caps, and Modifiers apply only to spells of this Path.

path_mending.name: Path of Mending
path_mending.system.description:
A Biomancy specialization: working with the body's template; the mender drives flesh back to what it used to be.

  • Affinity: −1 AP on Healing and Targets.
  • Lifts the Healing cap: all ranks 1–5 are available (without the Path, only 1–3).
  • Restrictions: Adaptation no higher than rank 3; Range no higher than rank 2 (up to 10 m, to reach through the line).
  • Tempo: combat. No saving throw is called for, since the body consents; Mending has no long casts.

This talent unlocks a doctrine Path. The “no path” build always remains available; the Path's affinities, caps, and Modifiers apply only to spells of this Path.

path_sculpting.name: Path of Sculpting
path_sculpting.system.description:
A Biomancy specialization: working against the body's template; the sculptor holds flesh in a foreign shape until it slides back.

  • Affinity: −1 AP on Adaptation and Duration.
  • Lifts the Adaptation cap: all ranks 1–5 are available (without the Path, only 1–3).
  • Restrictions: Healing no higher than rank 3; Range is touch only: sculpting is done by hand.
  • Long casts: a monopoly of this Path. The same trait from the catalog, sculpted over hours, lasts until a Long Rest instead of rounds.
  • Divergence step 2 (a trait of another Bloodline) requires donor tissue of that Bloodline with a rank no lower than the trait's rank.

This talent unlocks a doctrine Path. The “no path” build always remains available; the Path's affinities, caps, and Modifiers apply only to spells of this Path.

path_squall.name: Path of the Squall
path_squall.system.description:
A Ventomancy specialization: wind as an element of scale, a squall that sweeps over a formation.

  • Affinity: −1 AP on Area: Cone and Area: Radius.
  • Damage, forms, and Modifiers as for the doctrine: untyped, steps II–VI, slashing form, Knockdown, Dust Veil, Choke.

This talent unlocks a doctrine Path. The “no path” build always remains available; the Path's affinities, caps, and Modifiers apply only to spells of this Path.

pattern_recognition.name: Pattern Recognition
pattern_recognition.system.description: If the character falls exactly 1 short of success on a check related to investigation or searching for clues, the result counts as a success. The GM must signal when “something doesn't add up” during an investigation, even if the character hasn't asked directly.

penetrating_strike.name: Penetrating Strike
penetrating_strike.system.description:
This talent grants @UUID[Compendium.dedrel.maneuvers.Item.EAb2rrgB0ew8Cnmr]{Penetrating Strike}

You use two limbs and your body weight to deal extra piercing damage equal to your Strength rank.

phantom_tread.name: Phantom Tread
phantom_tread.system.description:
This talent grants @UUID[Compendium.dedrel.maneuvers.Item.OzLWpsHxnDHRrBdg]{Phantom Tread}

You read the enemy's stance and slip through right where they're waiting for you.

Effect: until the end of this turn, your movement through enemy Control Zones doesn't provoke Attacks of Opportunity.

What it doesn't do: it doesn't free you from a clinch (that's what Disengage is for). Nor does it protect you from reactions with their own trigger: Preemptive Thrust triggers on entering a Control Zone, not on an Attack of Opportunity, and will still stop you.

plant_berdiche.name: Plant the Berdiche
plant_berdiche.system.description:
This talent grants @UUID[Compendium.dedrel.maneuvers.Item.bB8yF8TDgjBrnmWz]{Plant the Berdiche}

Applies the Berdiche Planted status.
While you reload a musket, you don't provoke an Attack of Opportunity in melee; the berdiche counts as equipped, and switching from the musket is a free action. If the character moves away or is knocked back two meters or more, the status is removed. The player can choose whether the character grabbed the berdiche or left it standing in place.

Lets you perform the Braced Shot maneuver.
As a chain, you can make @UUID[Compendium.dedrel.maneuvers.Item.YYchgwfcVR4BNpUX]{Reload} or @UUID[Compendium.dedrel.maneuvers.Item.iS2JkbQLJEEM7tO3]{Braced Shot}

portent.name: Portent
portent.system.description: At the start of each combat, before the first turn, roll 2d10 and remember the results. At any time before the end of combat, you can replace any d10 roll, yours or an opponent's, with one of the remembered values. Each value can be used only once.

power_bash.name: Power Bash
power_bash.system.description:
This talent grants @UUID[Compendium.dedrel.maneuvers.Item.u2MUNJ2oJeExQuzq]{Power Bash}

You take a big swing to deal extra damage equal to your Strength rank.

preemptive_thrust.name: Preemptive Strike
preemptive_thrust.system.description:
This talent grants @UUID[Compendium.dedrel.maneuvers.Item.Pp79Pln9JPEb7ZCb]{Preemptive Thrust}

When an opponent enters your Control Zone, you can use a reaction to make a spear attack. If the attack hits (even if it deals no damage), the enemy stops, and the maneuver that gave them the movement is disrupted. As a chain, you can make a @UUID[Compendium.dedrel.maneuvers.Item.QxeLaAzEcKygoZdj]{Thrust}

punishing_miss.name: Punishing Miss
punishing_miss.system.description:
This talent grants @UUID[Compendium.dedrel.maneuvers.Item.AB0Q2InegZxKsBu3]{Punishing Miss}

Like @UUID[Compendium.dedrel.maneuvers.Item.vMmgn6eWaoidERxE]{Riposte}, but it can be activated after an opponent misses.

pyromancy.name: Pyromancy
pyromancy.system.description:
Control over heat, flame, and light. The king of direct damage.

  • Damage: fire (heat), Ladder steps III–VII.
  • Incineration: ranks of the Damage Modifier sit one step higher than for every other doctrine.
  • Affinity: −1 AP on Damage.
  • Restriction: +1 AP on Accuracy.
  • Forms: unavailable; Pyromancy burns with pure heat.
  • Ignite: a spell that deals damage to a target sets it on fire (the Burning condition, if the target can burn).

rally.name: Rally
rally.system.description:
This talent grants @UUID[Compendium.dedrel.maneuvers.Item.y4ZAVThQ4kkxM5C4]{Rally}

Maneuver, Action.

All allies within 20 m shed [🔧 placeholder: minor negative conditions] and get +2 to all rolls until the start of your next turn.

ranged_riposte.name: Ranged Riposte
ranged_riposte.system.description:
This talent grants @UUID[Compendium.dedrel.maneuvers.Item.VPXOjhExSbvL2VvW]{Ranged Riposte}

When a ranged attack is made against you (successful or not), you can react by firing back (you must have a ranged weapon equipped)

reserve_stamina.name: Reserve Stamina
reserve_stamina.system.description:
This talent grants @UUID[Compendium.dedrel.maneuvers.Item.6tvGOWHSL6vm2pw2]{Reserve Stamina}

3 times per Short Rest.
Instantly restore Universal Action Points up to your Constitution rank.

rewrite_moment.name: Rewrite the Moment
rewrite_moment.system.description:
This talent grants @UUID[Compendium.dedrel.maneuvers.Item.1uCcDGj4HXoWcZ0i]{Rewrite the Moment}

Reaction. When you take damage, you can activate this talent. The opponent's attack is canceled entirely, with all its consequences (damage, conditions, effects). The AP the opponent spent are not refunded.

shadowmancy.name: Shadowmancy
shadowmancy.system.description:
Power over darkness, withering, and dead flesh. A debuffer: “Shadow weakens.”

  • Damage: necrotic, steps II–VI.
  • Targeted only: Areas (cone, radius, line) are forbidden.
  • Affinity: −1 AP on Duration: curses linger.
  • Restriction: +1 AP on Damage.
  • Doctrinal Modifier: the full Power catalog, the doctrine's signature tool.
  • Source: corpses and darkness. A cemetery or catacombs are an abundant source; a battlefield with fresh corpses counts as “source available.”

The doctrine is in draft form; its mechanics may change after playtests.

sharp_mind.name: Sharp Mind
sharp_mind.system.description:
+2 to Logic saving throws.

On Add Macro:
@saves.log.bonus +2

shield_bash.name: Shield Bash
shield_bash.system.description:
This talent grants @UUID[Compendium.dedrel.maneuvers.Item.RqvEocSQqKFVXtbj]{Shield Bash}

You must hold a shield.

You deliver a powerful shield blow to the opponent using the Athletics skill. If the attack succeeds, you knock the opponent back by Constitution RANK *2 meters. Damage on the card = your Constitution rank.

sliding_step.name: Sliding Step
sliding_step.system.description: After an attack against your Dodge misses, you can make @UUID[Compendium.dedrel.maneuvers.Item.COx23vBpriCHVVLO]{Disengage} as a reaction.

sniper_shot.name: Sniper Shot
sniper_shot.system.description:
This talent grants @UUID[Compendium.dedrel.maneuvers.Item.zdHgW5kc1fzEGuVL]{Sniper Shot}

Musket or crossbow

The target must be at least 20 m away.

Attack with a +2 bonus.

You choose the hit location: Arms, Torso, Legs, Head. If the attack deals at least 5 damage (after DR), the target suffers an injury.

soul_of_the_crowd.name: Soul of the Crowd
soul_of_the_crowd.system.description: Address a group of people (from a dozen to a thousand). Make a Persuasion, Intimidation, or Deception check against a DC set by the GM. On a success, the group of NPCs adopts your point of view or takes the action you need. The scale of the effect is proportional to the DC.

sovereign_will.name: Sovereign Will
sovereign_will.system.description:
This talent grants @UUID[Compendium.dedrel.maneuvers.Item.0lbAvOq416OQzRkh]{Sovereign Will (WIP)}

All enemies within a radius of 2+WILL squares make a WILL check against your WILL+12. Failure: [🔧 placeholder: Terror]. Success: [🔧 placeholder: minor status].

Comments: consider introducing an “aura” entity

steel_barrier.name: Steel Barrier
steel_barrier.system.description:
This talent grants @UUID[Compendium.dedrel.maneuvers.Item.SV2SH36D9xsyZ19G]{Steel Barrier}

You spin your sword, creating a no-go zone around you until the start of your next turn. The first enemy to enter your Control Zone takes an automatic hit from you, after which the maneuver ends.

While you hold the stance, you don't move. Move even a meter and the barrier drops. Activating another maneuver before the barrier triggers also cancels it.

steel_momentum.name: Steel Momentum
steel_momentum.system.description:
This talent grants @UUID[Compendium.dedrel.maneuvers.Item.tqM7tetp1p2BCh2u]{Steel Momentum}

If at the end of your last turn you started @UUID[Compendium.dedrel.maneuvers.Item.SV2SH36D9xsyZ19G]{Steel Barrier} and it didn't trigger before the start of your new turn, at the start of the turn you can use Steel Momentum: move up to your Speed and make an attack; on a hit, the damage is increased by one step.

This is a free action, and you can continue your turn.

sunder_block.name: Sunder Block
sunder_block.system.description:
Grants a maneuver.

Make an attack with a falchion or axe against the target's opposed Athletics roll. On a success, the target gains the Off Guard status (the status forbids using Block) against the next attack.

As a chain, you may make a @UUID[Compendium.dedrel.maneuvers.Item.lHGticf7d6hKImJ6]{Swing}.

superposition.name: Superposition
superposition.system.description:
This talent grants @UUID[Compendium.dedrel.maneuvers.Item.2Ow7yTA7lTa9T3Wq]{Superposition}

Maneuver. You place up to 4 copies of your character on the battlefield within line of sight. Each copy has 1 HP and vanishes after taking damage. After an opponent makes an attack against one of your tokens, you choose whether it hits a copy or the real character. On your turn you also decide which token is your character.

supreme_athleticism.name: Supreme Athleticism
supreme_athleticism.system.description: You add your full Strength rank to Athletics checks.

sweeping_arc.name: Sweeping Arc
sweeping_arc.system.description:
Grants a maneuver

Using a glaive, you make a wide swing, attacking up to 3 enemies in a 4 m cone with a single roll. Damage is also rolled once and applied to all of them.

swing_on_a_move.name: Swing on the Move
swing_on_a_move.system.description:
This talent grants @UUID[Compendium.dedrel.maneuvers.Item.hrkYLX9Zy60dKn2C]{Swing on the Move}

You don't stand still: you cut on the run, breaking distance and coming in from a new side. The attack is part of the maneuver itself; you don't need a separate Swing after it.

Carousel. The first use spends your Action; each next one chains after the previous, and so on as long as you have AP and meters of Speed.

Conditions:

  • You must move at least 2 meters between attacks.
  • The carousel can't be interrupted by other maneuvers: interrupt it and it's over.
  • Each attack is against a new target: the carousel never hits the same opponent twice in one turn.
  • If an enemy Control Zone stops you (for example, with Preemptive Thrust), the maneuver is broken off.

tactical_breakdown.name: Tactical Breakdown
tactical_breakdown.system.description:
This talent grants @UUID[Compendium.dedrel.maneuvers.Item.xaw6eSKFwFXitkzJ]{Tactical Breakdown}

Maneuver, free action. Choose one opponent. Until the end of the round, all allies within 20 meters of you get against this target: +2 to attacks and the right to reroll one damage die (the new result must be kept).

taunt.name: Taunt
taunt.system.description:
This talent grants @UUID[Compendium.dedrel.maneuvers.Item.YVl6pkv3tAM5k5YD]{Taunt}

The target must be able to hear you and have a developed mind.
Persuasion check against the target's Insight.
If the target fails, it takes a -3 penalty to attacks against targets other than the taunter until the start of the next turn.

technique_create.name: Technique: Create
technique_create.system.description: Conjures energy/matter from the Astral where there is none. For example, lights a torch.

technique_imbue.name: Technique: Infuse
technique_imbue.system.description: Infuses a magical property of the Doctrine into a target (object/creature).

technique_move.name: Technique: Move
technique_move.system.description: Controls the movement and position of an already existing source. For example: hurl fire.

technique_sense.name: Technique: Sense
technique_sense.system.description: Gathers information about the Doctrine without making physical changes.

technique_transform.name: Technique: Transform
technique_transform.system.description: Changes the inner properties of matter/energy, but not its position.

thread_of_fate.name: Thread of Fate
thread_of_fate.system.description: You ask the GM one question strictly in the form: “What do I need to do to [X]?” The GM must give an honest and specific answer about an existing path to the goal. The GM doesn't have to make that path easy or safe. The intuitive sees the direction, not the outcome.

through_the_pain.name: Through the Pain
through_the_pain.system.description:
This talent grants @UUID[Compendium.dedrel.maneuvers.Item.oV4BXCAQLoBVjnWM]{Through the Pain}

3 times per Long Rest

Free action. You ignore wound penalties until the end of the round.

unbreakable.name: Unbreakable
unbreakable.system.description:
This talent grants @UUID[Compendium.dedrel.maneuvers.Item.t7fPr5KCAThyxKvQ]{Unbreakable}

Once per Long Rest.

You ignore any damage the first time you take it within the next 10 rounds.

uncanny_metabolism.name: Uncanny Metabolism
uncanny_metabolism.system.description:
This talent grants @UUID[Compendium.dedrel.maneuvers.Item.Sj8P3gF3cgbs4hxY]{Uncanny Metabolism}

Maneuver, free action. You get a -1 AP discount on all maneuvers for the next three rounds (but not below 1).

unnerving_presence.name: Unnerving Presence
unnerving_presence.system.description:
This talent grants @UUID[Compendium.dedrel.maneuvers.Item.wnWWCQ1EdneoDSPN]{Unnerving Presence}

CHA vs the target's WILL check. On a success: [🔧 placeholder: minor debuff] for 2 rounds. Narratively: not fear, but a feeling that the opponent has already lost.

untamed_might.name: Untamed Might
untamed_might.system.description:
Increases your chance to resist effects that require a Strength saving throw. +2 to STR saving throws.

On Add Macro:
@saves.str.bonus +2

vector_glide.name: Vector Glide
vector_glide.system.description:
This talent grants @UUID[Compendium.dedrel.maneuvers.Item.gMEjIkxkE8XmSv1w]{Vector Glide}

You break into a run that gravity doesn't care about.

Effect: until the end of this turn you run on vertical surfaces and water. Movement is normal, in meters of Speed.

Risk: if your movement ends on a vertical surface or on water, the character falls (for fall damage, see the rules).

ventomancy.name: Ventomancy
ventomancy.system.description:
Command over winds and sounds.

  • Damage: untyped, steps II–VI.
  • Restriction: +1 AP on Damage and Accuracy. Wind and sound strike an area and the senses, not with a point. The doctrine doesn't touch Durability at all: air holds no shape and creates no constructs.
  • Form: slashing (wind blade).
  • Doctrinal Modifiers: Knockdown, Dust Veil, Choke, available to any ventomancer.

Specializations are unlocked by separate talents: Path of the Squall (−1 AP on cone and radius) and Path of the Echo (−1 AP on Power, Targets, and Duration, sonic damage, Power ranks 1–3).

volt_step.name: Volt Step
volt_step.system.description:
This talent grants @UUID[Compendium.dedrel.maneuvers.Item.lMsbHM4XnCRLxefs]{Volt Step}

Maneuver, reaction. After an opponent's melee attack roll, but before the GM confirms the hit and rolls damage, spend up to 5 AP and add the same amount to Dodge until the end of this round.

weak_morale.name: Low Morale
weak_morale.system.description:
The creature fights for money or out of fear, not for a cause. It checks morale.

Trigger (once per combat). Damage has brought it to its last threshold:

  • peon: one Hit left;
  • regular / elite / boss: the wound track has reached level 4 (25% HP or less).

The roll. A Willpower saving throw, DC 9. If it holds, it fights to the end and doesn't check again.

Failure. From its next turn it doesn't attack: it flees (all movement away from the nearest enemy; leaving a Control Zone provokes an Attack of Opportunity) or surrenders; the GM decides which fits better.

Cancellation. While a bearer of the Pack Alpha talent is alive and conscious nearby, the check isn't made at all.

No automation: clicking the talent posts this reminder to chat; the saving throw is a click on Willpower in the sheet header.

weak_spot.name: Weak Spot
weak_spot.system.description:
This talent grants @UUID[Compendium.dedrel.maneuvers.Item.KRGHho0GBoNiiHGB]{Weak Spot}

Before attacking, you declare that you are “reading” the opponent; your next attack with any weapon gains Armor Piercing 3

will_aura.name: Aura of Will
will_aura.system.description:
This talent grants @UUID[Compendium.dedrel.maneuvers.Item.gXMDw2cok8GFwXbM]{Aura of Will}

For 10 rounds, all allies within 10 meters get +2 to Willpower saving throws.

world_favors_me.name: The World Favors Me
world_favors_me.system.description:
This talent grants @UUID[Compendium.dedrel.maneuvers.Item.Gkn4UxC4PlG46Fal]{The World Favors Me}

Free action. Until the end of the round, the surrounding objects and environment work in your favor: a mechanism jams, a rope snaps, a stone rolls away. The GM brings the effect to life based on context. It can't deal damage or apply conditions directly, only change the surroundings.
